To prevent potential TypeErrors and ensure the system fails closed gracefully, filter out non-record entries from `locatorBackfill?.rows` before processing them, in accordance with the repository's general rules.

```javascript
  const locatedRows = asArray(locatorBackfill?.rows)
    .filter(isRecord)
    .filter((row) => PAGE_LOCATED_STATUSES.has(row?.inventory_status));
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. When processing collections of assets or inputs, normalize the input using an array helper (e.g., `asArray`) and filter out non-record entries before mapping or flat-mapping over them to prevent TypeErrors on null, undefined, or non-array inputs.
</details>
